convert_checkpoint_dequantize: convert a DeepSeek checkpoint from FP8_BLOCK quantization back to dense bfloat16 format
create_quantization_recipe: create a quantization recipe with NVFP4 for MLP layers and FP8_BLOCK for self-attention layers
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply oneshot quantization to a model using a calibration dataset and quantization recipe
load_offloaded_model: load a large model with automatic CPU and disk offloading to fit within available memory
save_compressed_model: save a quantized model to disk in compressed format with tokenizer
